checks_run.procedure: Line-level review of git diff 71ff750ed..f56f1b3d2 outside docs/delivery (11 files, +783/-46): every path that feeds earlier turns or records to the model, migration 0129, the inheritance cap, the 0128→0129 window, and the fake-model disclosure.
checks_run.environment: Main repository and the clone, read-only
checks_run.expected: No defect
checks_run.actual:
No defect found.
- Paths to the model: answer.ts:142 is the only provider.complete call, and postAssistantMessage (conversations.ts:814) is the only caller of answer. The model gets exactly the system text, historyFor's history, the retrieval data block and the prompt. Retrieval runs as the caller with limit min(max_context_records, 20) (retrieval.ts:157). Suggestions and audit events never re-enter the model.
- historyFor (:465) uses the same withheld() predicate as toMessageView for first.fresh, so a revocation committed before transaction 1 is honoured. A revocation between historyFor and the provider call is covered by the inherited context: the stored answer is then withheld at read time, and the postAssistantMessage response re-checks with the principal of transaction 2.
- The owner's own prompts stay, which is correct: they are served as typed.
- The cap. A conversation refuses a post above 98 messages (:788), so there are at most 49 earlier answers, each given at most 20 records, and every inherited key comes from this conversation's own data blocks. The history union is at most 980. The budget 1000 − max_context_records (:485) plus a data block of at most max_context_records keeps the total within 0129's bound of 1000 (:35). This holds even when max_context_records changes mid-conversation, because the budget and the data block use the same setting row. When the guard bites, it drops the answer from both the history and the context, so it fails closed.
- 0129: the triggers are BEFORE INSERT ROW with a fixed search_path and the same SQLSTATE and constraint name. Immutability (0128) still forbids a later NULL to value change. Widening the IMMUTABLE shape function only relaxes the bound, so no stored row becomes invalid. The upgrade from 0128 equals the fresh path (SEC-R3-18).
- 0128→0129 window. An answer stored by a 0128-level build that had repeated an earlier answer holds only its own data block, so after the upgrade it stays readable if the earlier answer's record is revoked. Defence 1 still keeps it from being re-sent if it is itself withheld. I judge this residual acceptable, not a finding: 0111, 0128 and 0129 all ship in the same unreleased P6 release (DG6 not approved), so no released installation holds such rows. It is stated in the data dictionary's 0129 'Effect on deploy'.
- The pre-0128 citation-only limit is unchanged and documented in ADR-0059 §9.
- fake-model.ts gains only answerFrom and messagesOf (test support).
